user.title: HomeKit Camera Live
user.description: Adds live video to the cameras you've paired with HomeKit Controller, using the pairing Home Assistant already has. Nothing is paired again and no entities are added: the cameras you have start offering live view.

abort.single_instance_allowed: HomeKit Camera Live is already set up.
abort.no_go2rtc: No go2rtc binary was found. Home Assistant OS and the official container include it; see the README for other installs.

data_description.srtp_port: The UDP port your cameras send video to. It must be reachable from the cameras and free on this machine.
